title.rendered: I Am God’s Workmanship: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do. You are not an accident. You are the deliberate craftsmanship of the Master Artist.

content.rendered:
For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do. You are not an accident in the universe. You are the deliberate craftsmanship of the Master Artist, with works already waiting for you.

The Gospel For Today | Friday, July 10, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.”
Ephesians 2:10 (NIV)

Today’s Message

The Greek word Paul uses for “handiwork” is poiēma. It is the word from which we get the English word “poem.” It carries the sense of a deliberate, artistic creation, a thing made with care, intention and craftsmanship. The believer is not a manufactured item rolling off an assembly line. The believer is a poem written by God Himself, created in Christ Jesus with deliberate artistry.

Paul places this verse immediately after Ephesians 2:8-9, the most quoted passage in the Bible on grace through faith. The order matters. Paul says first that the believer is saved by grace through faith, not by works. Then he immediately turns and says that we are God’s poem, created for good works that He prepared in advance for us to do. Salvation is not by works. Salvation is for works. The good works do not earn the standing. The good works flow from the standing.

And notice the timeline. The good works were prepared in advance. Before you were born, before you knew you would believe, before you understood there were such things as good works, God was preparing assignments for you to walk into. Every encounter you will have today, every conversation, every small act of love, every faithful step in your work, every quiet moment of obedience, was prepared for you in advance by the Father who knew you would be reading these words on this exact morning.

This changes how the day looks. The believer is not searching for something to do for God. The believer is walking into something God has already prepared. The good works are not a burden to be added to an already-busy day. They are doorways the Father has placed in your path. Some days the doorway will be a difficult conversation handled with grace. Some days it will be a kind word to a stranger. Some days it will be a moment of generosity, a prayer for someone, a step of faith. None of them are accidents. All of them were prepared in advance.

For Gospelbuzz readers, today is filled with prepared works. You will not need to manufacture them. You will not need to strain after them. You will walk into them by walking in the Spirit, alert to what He has already arranged. You are God’s poem, created in Christ for good works. Walk in them today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I am Your handiwork, Your poem, created in Christ Jesus for good works that You prepared for me in advance. I am not an accident. I am not random. I am the deliberate craftsmanship of the Master Artist. The works of this day have already been prepared for me to walk into. I receive them today. I am alert to the doorways You have placed in my path. I walk in them by Your Spirit, confident that nothing I do today in obedience is wasted. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am God’s handiwork. I am His poem. I am created in Christ Jesus for good works that He prepared for me in advance. I walk in them today.
